title: Earnings volatility and earnings predictability
sources_checked: Resolved the assigned resource-catalog reference through project_layout to output/feasibility_reproduction/resources/catalog.json; it lists COMP.FUNDA and COMP.G_EXRT_DLY at the same paths used by the accepted construction. The matching local SAS catalog is PROC CONTENTS source catalog (COMP.FUNDA block lines 26943–26966; COMP.G_EXRT_DLY block lines 29100–29123).

Current local COMP.FUNDA: ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_na/funda.sas7bdat; SAS metadata label “Merged Fundamental Annual File”, created 2026-07-20, modified 2026-07-22, 941,340 rows and 949 columns. Aggregate selected-field check applying FYEAR 1983–2014, FYR=12, INDFMT=INDL, DATAFMT=STD, CONSOL=C, POPSRC=D found rows through 2014 (8,690 in FYEAR 2014) and zero duplicate GVKEY–FYEAR keys in that bounded interval.

Current local COMP.G_EXRT_DLY: ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_global/currency/g_exrt_dly.sas7bdat; SAS metadata label “Exchange Rate Daily”, created 2026-07-20, modified 2026-08-14, 2,221,564 rows and 5 columns; GBP target quotes cover 1982-02-01 through 2026-07-19. In 2005–2014 there were no duplicate date/currency quote groups; all 79,955 selected Compustat own-DATADATE/currency rows in those years matched one positive unique quote (13,098 CAD and 66,857 USD rows).

Accepted attempt_03 handoff metadata checked with pyreadstat metadataonly=True, without reading observations: lowercase fyear is numeric (%10.0g) and labeled Data Year - Fiscal; datadate is retained; gvkey is string. The fresh work/data/reg.dta metadata has the same names and types, so the extension diagnostics use the actual lowercase numeric fyear variable.

Accepted construction and predecessor evidence: output/reproductions/packages/W3123899283/attempt_03/build.sas, stata.ipynb, submission.json, and outcome.json; paper sample record W3123899283 (PDF p. 4) and extracted model locations (Tables 2–4).
changes: Rebuilt the same Compustat and FX construction jointly over required source years through 2014, extending the analysis FYEAR endpoint from 2004 to 2009 while preserving the 1988 start, four-year cash-flow/earnings history, five-year volatility window, exact fiscal-year joins, current asset threshold, trimming rules, firm-level split, pooled volatility quintiles, and original horizon definitions.

Extended the SAS annual and FX source bounds to include observations/quotes through 2014; the candidate observation window is FYEAR 1988–2009. This preserves outcomes through t+5 for the 2009 target year.

Added computed Stata e(sample) counts for FYEAR 1988–2004 and 2005–2009 and a computed last contributing FYEAR after each assigned regression. All 21 markers report positive counts in both periods and last_added=2009. Regression commands and estimator are unchanged.

The pooled sample, percentile cutoffs, firm split membership, and volatility ranks were rebuilt over the expanded candidate period; the accepted fixed seed 20261102 and PROC RANK convention were retained.
limitations: The Compustat vintage used by the paper and the original random split seed are unavailable. The accepted reconstruction already had 26,236 full-sample and 13,175 exploratory firm-years for the original 1988–2004 period versus 22,113 and 11,061 reported by the paper; the discrepancy remains unresolved and neither the paper sample size nor its split membership is forced.

The predecessor source audit found OANCF absent in 1983–1986 and present in only 785 observations in 1987. The unchanged four-prior-year CFO history requirement therefore prevents target-year fits in 1988–1990; no cash-flow proxy is introduced. `original_begin` records the paper/design window (1988), while actual regression counts come from e(sample).

The paper does not identify the principal regression estimator or covariance correction. The accepted reconstruction and extension use the existing intercept-inclusive OLS with conventional standard errors.
The paper does not specify the percentile algorithm or tied-volatility quintile assignment; pooled PROC UNIVARIATE cutoffs and PROC RANK defaults remain as in the accepted construction.

The paper does not report Table 2 Panel B per-quintile N. The extended Stata tables report actual horizon-specific Ns; the native EXT_SAMPLE markers separately report actual original/added e(sample) counts.

The extension task assigns the 21 baseline fits only. The notebook auxiliary Stata interaction tests and exploratory Stata descriptives are not assigned replay scopes and were not re-executed; the SAS build retains its existing aggregate sample checks and pseudo-quintile simulations.

The accepted construction uses the provider-documented own-DATADATE GBP cross-rate for the $100 million non-USD asset screen. It requires positive unique FX quotes; the current 2005–2014 checked annual rows all satisfy the exact quote join. Currency-change and unavailable-denominator rows remain subject to the original construction rules.
